scope: Permitted 40-profile clean subset; 38 current keepers assessed and two leavers explicitly retained outside the current cohort.
decision_boundary: Evidence-led interview triage only; not a competence, eligibility or mobilisation determination.

method.work_evidence: Every clean log entry for each profile is reviewed. An entry normally needs an explicit maintenance action plus an electrical or mechanical plant term; superficial numeric/template variants are collapsed. Up to five strongest examples are shown, except named material records needed to explain a conflict. Counts, hours and repetition are not competence.
method.appraisals: Every appraisal carrying an exact current-cohort keeper_code is reviewed. Name-only/null-key rows are not attached. Only role-relevant testimony is repeated. Year-only 2026 records are context-only because their timing relative to 2026-10-11 is unknown; future years are excluded from conclusions.
method.decision_categories: supported_technical_interview; targeted_screening_first; insufficient_evidence; outside_current_redeployment_cohort. The categories are rule-based gates, not a score or ranking.
method.supported_technical_interview: At least five distinct relevant log examples and no explicit role-related appraisal concern in the ten years before the cutoff.
method.targeted_screening_first: Relevant evidence exists, but it is sparse or explicit recent role-related appraisal concerns need focused resolution before a full technical interview.
method.insufficient_evidence: Fewer than three distinct relevant log examples and no strong keeper-code-keyed manager support.
method.training: Dated LearnHub outcome and supplied expiry are evaluated at the explicit cutoff. Pass, Attended and Not achieved remain distinct. A nominal scheme-rule date is also shown; when it changes cutoff status, neither date is chosen and issuer verification is required.
method.height_mapping: WAHS-1 is used as the supplied definition's direct height-safety module. This is a documented interpretation because the posting asks for a combined offshore certificate while OSSC itself has no height module.
method.identity: Raw keeper codes, payroll references and names are identified separately. Integer-like payroll values may be normalized across leading-zero, decimal and scientific notation only; absent or conflicting identifiers remain explicit and clean attribution is never rewritten.
method.action_dependencies: Issuer verification precedes spending decisions; working-condition willingness is confirmed before courses; medical clearance precedes OSSC; verified OSSC-SS precedes WAHS. The posting funds renewals but does not promise first-time training funding.
